metadata.case_name: AMBARINI BT SAHARI KASTO v. FOK KA CHING

source: (c) The plaintiff was diagnosed with Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (“PTSD”). She was given sertraline 25 mg daily and propranolol 10 mg three times daily. It was difficult to give comment on the prognosis in the early stage of treatment.

(b) The plaintiff was diagnosed to be having PTSD. Her PTSD was at a severe level immediately after the Incidents while she was living in the shelter. The degree was assessed to be moderate at the time when the solo psychiatric examination took place.

injuries.description: Major Depressive Disorder, Single Episode, Moderate
source: (a) The plaintiff was diagnosed to be having Major Depressive Disorder, Single Episode, Moderate.

manifestations.description: repeated flashbacks of her previous rape incident
bad dreams of being chased by someone
higher levels of anxiety when she is alone with males

treatments_received.treatment: Attended the A&E department of Queen Elizabeth Hospital on 17 September 2011
source: After the Incidents, the plaintiff attended the A&E department of Queen Elizabeth Hospital on 17 September 2011 and was attended by Dr Chan Ho Kit.

treatments_received.treatment: First sought psychiatric treatment from Yung Fung Shee Psychiatric Centre on 14 August 2015
source: The plaintiff first sought psychiatric treatment from Yung Fung Shee Psychiatric Centre on 14 August 2015.

treatments_received.treatment: Sertraline 25 mg daily and propranolol 10 mg three times daily
source: (c) The plaintiff was diagnosed with Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (“PTSD”). She was given sertraline 25 mg daily and propranolol 10 mg three times daily. It was difficult to give comment on the prognosis in the early stage of treatment.
(a) The plaintiff had received appropriate psychiatric treatment to date. She had received antidepressant treatment for three months.

treatments_future.treatment: continue medications and follow up at the psychiatric clinic at one to two monthly intervals for a term of 3 years
source: (b) She should continue medications and follow up at the psychiatric clinic at one to two monthly intervals. She is likely to require treatment for three years following the date of the Solo Psychiatric Report.

treatments_future.treatment: commence treatment by a clinical psychologist at intervals of one to two months for two years
source: (c) She is also recommended to commence treatment by a clinical psychologist at intervals of one to two months for two years.

losses.description: The plaintiff's husband blamed her after becoming aware of the Incidents and her marriage was broken because of the Incidents.

Permanent impairment in the form of reduced efficiency at work, poor concentration and attention, lower ability to withstand stress and higher levels of anxiety is likely to affect her ability to function effectively as a domestic helper.

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: She remains scared when she sees men resembling the defendant and avoids visiting certain areas in Kowloon.
